page.layout: One column of verse, lines set with indents, no margin notes, no running head, no page number, no catchword or signature. Right-hand show-through and left-edge marks are not transcribed.

main_text.p: Candida ceu micat inter astra Minora PHOEBE: quēque HELICONIDUM Tam sævienti tempore vindicem Sentit potentem cœtus, & qui Sacra colunt veneranda PHOEBI. Secura præbens ocia quos foues, Lætisque tristes hospitiis iuvas: Dum bella commotum per orbem Spargit atrox truculenta Mauors. Dum regna GALLUS GALLICA civicis Conatur ardens perdere motibus, Et gentis HISPANÆ superbos Stultus amat tolerare fasces. Dum iura grandi dote superbior Vxoris audet REGULUS ALLOBROX Ignota vicinis minari, Barbaricasque ferox secures. Et nostra forti vertere moenia, Domosque cunctas cogitat agmine: Parvosque natos, atque castas Cum patribus iugulare matres. Heu damna captæ quanta furens daret Victor GENEVÆ, ni DEVS impetum, Viresque vesanas cruenti
Note: the text is verse in one unbroken block, so it is given as one paragraph.

page.notes: Doubtful readings: "quēque" (the macron over the e is faint). Some capitals (VXORIS, GALLVS, REGVLVS, HELICONIDVM, DEVS) are printed with V; following the u/v rule I wrote the vowel as U. The "Vxoris" initial is a consonant V and is kept. A dark spot sits on "natos" and "Victor" may be read as Victor. Show-through from the reverse page is ignored.
